recipe.visualDefinition: A series of nine sharp, metallic, claw-like shards arranged in a downward-pointing arc against a solid black background. The shards feature a weathered, brushed metal texture with high-contrast highlights and deep shadows, suggesting a primitive yet technologically advanced aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry along a curved horizontal axis
High contrast between reflective metallic surfaces and absolute black void
Repetition of form with slight variations in angle and length
coreInvariants: Metallic texture with bronze and silver highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The claw arc is positioned in the upper third of the frame, occupying approximately 25% of the total vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central, longest claw serves as the vertical axis and primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the arc from left to right, then drops down into the expansive negative space below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 75% of the composition is empty black space, creating a sense of mystery and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast; the image relies on light reflecting off dark surfaces.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square. In the top third, render nine metallic, triangular shards arranged in a shallow U-shaped arc. The shards should have a weathered, hammered metal texture with sharp points facing downward. Apply harsh directional lighting from above to create bright silver highlights on the top edges and deep bronze reflections in the center of each shard.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, wide sans-serif font centered in the lower half of the negative space, using a subtle metallic gradient or white fill.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black without noise?
Do the shards have a realistic metallic sheen?

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on the shards

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance across the central shard.
Ensure highlights are not blown out to pure white without detail.
Verify the shards appear to be floating in a void.
Confirm the texture looks like cold, hard metal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Arrange [geometric elements] in a [curved path] against a [solid dark background] using [high-contrast metallic lighting] to create a [minimalist thematic] icon.
